thread:
jen: FYI support queue — several customers hitting 5xx/timeouts on /v1/generate since ~13:04 UTC. Error rate jumped from ~0.3% to ~11% in 12m. examples from customers: resumely, catalogly, shopmate. :rotating_light:
chris: I'm seeing a gateway spike, mostly 502/503 and a lot of `route_match failed: no compatible backend` in gateway logs. Latency also increased (p95 tokens +200ms).
maria: I deployed a rollout for `model-routing=v2` at 12:58 via rolloutctl. It was supposed to be a 1% canary for dedicated tenants but the selector looked off — might have matched `tenant:*` instead of `tenant:beta`.
alex: Several customers also reported auth errors in their app logs — they see `upstream error` then client retries. Billing alarm fired for a few accounts due to retries.
chris: grabbing gateway traces now. Quick grep of logs: ```
2026-03-17T13:06:01Z gateway[gw-02] ERROR route_match failed tenant=shopmate request_id=abc123
2026-03-17T13:06:01Z gateway[gw-02] WARN backend_request failed backend=runtime-v2 status=502 upstream_error="missing-tenant-header"
```
sre-oncall: paging infra — looks like v2 runtime expects `X-Tenant-ID` header set by router, but the new routing config added a transform that accidentally stripped that header for some paths. That would cause upstream 502.
jen: repro steps from support: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` — with the same token it returns 200 for some accounts and 502 for others. We can reproduce by toggling `X-Tenant-ID` presence.
maria: confirmed in dev: when header is missing, runtime responds with 502 due to strict tenant validation. The rollout config had this transform: ```yaml
transforms:
  - remove_header: X-Tenant-ID  # OOPS
```
It was meant for an unrelated private path. rolloutctl command used: `rolloutctl apply --name model-routing-v2 --percentage 1 --selector tenant:* --config-file /tmp/route-v2.yaml` — selector should have been `tenant:canary`.
alex: customers affected (resumely, shopmate, partnerX) have support tickets open. They want ETA and will mark as P1 if billing continues.
sre-oncall: immediate action: revert rollout to v1 and remove offending transform. Starting rollback now. @deploy-bot kick off rollback. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: rollback job started: job-id=rb-20260317-01
chris: adding temporary WAF rule to reject requests missing X-Tenant-ID to avoid backend hits while rollback proceeds. That should cut downstream retries.
maria: preparing a patch that tightens rollout selector and adds an integration test for header transforms. I'll push the hotfix after rollback completes.
support-bot: Noted — notified account owners for affected customers and set status -> incident: investigating.
deploy-bot: rollback job complete: job-id=rb-20260317-01 status=success timestamp=1729995600
chris: gateway 5xx % dropping back toward baseline. Monitoring shows p95 back within 50ms of previous. continuing to watch for 15m.
jen: please add a brief timeline in the ticket thread and tag AMs. Also include the curl repro snippet and the offending config snippet so accounts can see root cause.
maria: will follow up with a postmortem draft and include CI check to block rolloutctl commands that remove tenant headers.
sre-oncall: marking incident resolved-> mitigated. Will keep alerts muted for the next hour.
alex: I'll coordinate billing reconciliations for impacted customers and draft credit proposals.
jen: thanks everyone. postmortem notes: cause = rollout selector mistake + transform removal; impact = 5-12% 5xx spike for affected tenants, billing retries; mitigation = rollback + WAF rule; next steps = selector validation, CI test, account outreach.
chris: +1, will open tracking ticket for rolloutctl validation.
jen: closing channel for now, reopen if regressions reappear. :lock:
